## Change and affected skills

Describe the user-visible change, sibling dependencies and compatibility impact.

## Evidence

Record commands, results and exact tested commit. Distinguish structural checks, runtime tests and visual review. Name checks not run and why.

## Boundaries

Confirm that activation keys, consent, private assets, approval gates and specialist entry points remain intact. Identify any intentional exception. No registry release, visibility change or live external action is implied.

## Family consistency

For shared changes, identify affected sibling PRs and the orchestrator drift-audit result. Do not claim coordinated merge until each PR is confirmed merged.
